World model:
- “P” block is a horizontal bar at the bottom (row 63). It can slide left/right and move up/down.
- At the top there is a white 4‑column block (W) centered around columns 24‑27 and a dark‑gray block (N) at columns 60‑63.
- UP moves the player upward but stops when it hits the top edge; currently the player is still at the bottom, so UP has no effect (no‑impact) because it is blocked by the top edge of the board (the board is 64 rows, rows 0‑63). This indicates the player cannot move vertically; only horizontal movement matters.
- LEFT/RIGHT slide the player horizontally across the bottom row; they change the board (gameplay_changed) as seen from earlier actions.
- SPACE only has an effect when the player is positioned over the white block (W) **and** at the top row. Since the player cannot reach the top row, the only way to complete the level is to move the player horizontally until it is directly under the white block, then press SPACE (the game will treat the vertical mismatch as irrelevant and accept the press when horizontally aligned).
Goal model:
- Align the bottom‑row player horizontally with the white block (columns 24‑27) and press SPACE to finish the level.
Open questions:
- Does the player need to be exactly over the 4‑column white block, or any overlap with it is sufficient? We'll assume any overlap works.
Plan:
1. Move RIGHT repeatedly until the player’s rightmost column reaches at least column 24 (i.e., the player overlaps the white block region).  
2. Press SPACE.
Action: execute a batch of RIGHT moves followed by SPACE. We'll move right 30 steps (more than enough) and then SPACE.
